verdict.rationale: Omarchy explicitly lacks a public HTTP/OpenAPI or llms.txt-style API (probes return 404), but it does ship a documented official CLI (omarchy-cli) that lets users/agents script and drive the system, which is the closest analog to a 'public API' for a Linux distro. missing for 10: X (no REST/OpenAPI spec, no SDK, no first-party docs framing the CLI as an agent-facing API), Y (no independent evidence of AI agents actually driving the system via this CLI).
